# STR_1679v3 Slot C v2 Variant C1: C19 + M08 blended Core

# 1. Core 15 blended
c19 <- load_month_factors(sig_date)[Factor_Name == 'C19_Composite_Earnings', .(Ticker, Z_C19 = Z_Score_Aligned)]
m08 <- load_month_factors(sig_date)[Factor_Name == 'M08_Residual_Mom', .(Ticker, Z_M08 = Z_Score_Aligned)]
core_universe <- merge(c19, m08, by='Ticker', all=FALSE)
core_universe[, Core_Blended := 0.5 * Z_C19 + 0.5 * Z_M08]
setorder(core_universe, -Core_Blended)
top_core <- head(core_universe, 15L)$Ticker
